response.sql: WITH acct_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM acct_counts), diffs AS (SELECT ac.account_id, ac.region, ac.order_count, ac.order_count - o.avg_count AS diff FROM acct_counts ac CROSS JOIN overall o), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY region) SELECT d.account_id, d.region, d.order_count, d.diff AS diff_from_overall_avg, d.diff - r.region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM diffs d JOIN region_avg r ON r.region = d.region WHERE d.diff > r.region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
